# wowcensus

> Static World of Warcraft population census, auction-house, guild and zone
> pages, sampled in-game by the MarketLens addon (/who scans and AH scans).
> Numbers are frozen at build time and republished after each upload.

A /who sample shows currently-visible online players (server-capped), not a
full census. Auction quantities are listings, not sales. Money is in copper
(10000 copper = 1 gold).

## WoW Forever

- [Census](https://wowcensus.io/): sampled population, faction balance, race and class mix
- [Race + class](https://wowcensus.io/combos): the complete observed race and class combination breakdown
- [Auction house](https://wowcensus.io/auctionhouse): item supply, asking prices and listed value from recent scans
- [Guilds](https://wowcensus.io/guilds): sampled guild activity by realm and faction
- [Geography](https://wowcensus.io/geography): player activity by zone from latest-known character locations
- [Talents](https://wowcensus.io/talents): nearby inspected talent builds, inferred talent trees and selected talent popularity
- [census.json](https://wowcensus.io/census.json): the census data behind the page, as JSON
